verdict.rationale: BILL claims custom approval policies and says Spend & Expense makes every transaction "controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant." The API also exposes budgets, and AP approval policies control which bills need approval, by whom and when. However, none of the evidence shows expense-specific rules by category, role or context, or that in-policy expenses auto-approve while only exceptions go to a human; the approval-rule docs cover AP bills, not expenses. Missing for 10: documented expense policy rules with limits by category/role/context, auto-approval of in-policy expenses with exception-only routing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
